verdict.rationale: Elicit's Research Agent is documented as a conversational interface that runs operations from plain-language requests. You add extraction columns by telling the agent what you want, filters are detected and applied from your query, and you can filter, export, save papers, generate figures and draft slides without leaving the conversation. Search also accepts natural-language questions. Missing for 10: independent hands-on corroboration of command-style operation (as opposed to Q&A); some controls, such as the effort slider and library editing, are documented only as UI interactions.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can operate the product with natural-language commands

citations.quote: To add a column, simply tell the research agent what column(s) you'd like to add.
The simplest way to filter is to just say what you want in your Research Agent query. Elicit will automatically detect and apply the right filter.
filter and export your sources, save papers to your Library, generate figures, and draft slides, all without leaving the conversation
